statement: ∀ (u v : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ), 1 ≤ u → u ≤ v → 0 ≤ ρ.re → ρ ≠ 0 → ‖((v:ℂ)^ρ-(u:ℂ)^ρ)/ρ‖ ≤ (v:ℝ)^ρ.re * min (Real.log (v/u)) (2/‖ρ‖)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8005 · 为截断显式公式的单个零点给出双端点增量界
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8005 · Bound one zero contribution across two explicit-formula endpoints

brief.zh: 沿正实轴积分 x^(ρ−1) 得对数窗界，再用两个端点得 2/|ρ| 界。可按重数求和；该估计允许实零点靠近 1。
brief.en: Integrate x^(ρ−1) on the positive ray for the logarithmic width. Bound the endpoints for 2/|ρ|. Multiplicities survive summation and real zeros near one remain possible.
